title: SQL Server integrated: runMode SPEED is accepted with 450 tables

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022, integrated, 450 tables, runMode SPEED

symptom: Create accepted 450 objects with runMode SPEED. Within about two hours: 37 flow_progress events and 12 gc_pressure warnings. No table-limit error at create.
cause: Not established. A 50-table figure for SPEED wasn't found on the public SQL Server limits page (checked 2026-10-25).
effect: SPEED runs above that figure without an error.
fix: Check the current runMode limits before a large SPEED run.
notes: The destination stayed at 0 rows for about two hours (see sqlserver-integrated-lag-with-empty-destination).
